firmware.title: Radio-86RK (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The Radio-86RK, Spektr-001, Mikrosha and Apogey BK-01Ts, the 8080 kit computers. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
